text:
These two sources don't necessarily contradict each other, because they measure different things.

Hansen records when tree cover was lost. It shows 67.7 ha of loss in 2020, plus earlier losses in 2008, 2015 and 2017. It also shows only 23 ha of tree cover in 2000. JRC maps whether forest existed at the end of 2020. If the 2020 loss cleared the remaining forest, JRC showing 0 ha in 2020 is consistent with that.

Two caveats: the two datasets use different definitions and resolutions (30 m versus 10 m), and this evidence doesn't directly compare their overlap for the 2020 event. Also, 67.7 ha of loss exceeds the 23 ha of tree cover recorded in 2000, which is odd and not explained here. Regrowth or differing definitions could account for it, but I can't confirm that.

For the claim evaluated, the 2020 loss is baseline history. No loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected from 2021 to 2025, though small changes could be missed.
